components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one confirming action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #a998ff; color: #14121f; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'Sofia Sans Extra Condensed', 'Sofia Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a998ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Command Field
components.description: The typed query: chips for you, vs and the enemies, then the word being typed.
components.html: RAVS
components.css: .ds-cmd { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 44px; padding: 0 6px 0 12px; background: #16171b; border: 1px solid #33353c; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-cmd:focus-within { border-color: #a998ff; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'Sofia Sans Extra Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; color: #ebebee; } .ds-chip-you { background: rgba(169,152,255,0.15); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px #a998ff; } .ds-vs { font-family: 'Sofia Sans Extra Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; color: #8b8e97; } .ds-cmd-input { flex: 1; min-width: 64px; background: transparent; border: none; color: #ebebee; font: 500 15px 'Sofia Sans', sans-serif; outline: none; }

components.name: Item Row
components.description: One purchase in the six: icon, name, reason, gold spent.
components.html: ROD OF TAHUTI35% of Ra players buy it third10,500
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 48px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 64px; padding: 8px 14px 8px 10px; background: #16171b; border-radius: 12px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-row:hover { background: #1f2026; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a998ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-row-icon { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 8px; background: #292a31; } .ds-row-name { display: block; font-family: 'Sofia Sans Extra Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1; color: #ebebee; } .ds-row-why { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font: 400 13px/1.4 'Sofia Sans', sans-serif; color: #a6a9b2; } .ds-row-gold { font-family: 'Sofia Sans Extra Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 21px; color: #a6a9b2; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Mode Switch
components.description: Segmented control: aria-pressed buttons in a surface track.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); padding: 4px; background: #16171b; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-seg button { height: 44px; border: none; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: #a6a9b2; font-family: 'Sofia Sans Extra Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: #ebebee; } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed=true] { background: #a998ff; color: #14121f; } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a998ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Phone navigation: Build, Draft, Gods, More.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); background: rgba(16,17,20,0.95); border-top: 1px solid #33353c; } .ds-tabs a { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 64px; font-family: 'Sofia Sans Extra Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8b8e97; } .ds-tabs a[aria-current=page] { color: #ebebee; } .ds-tabs a[aria-current=page]::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 24px; right: 24px; height: 2px; background: #a998ff; } .ds-tabs a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a998ff; outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview: ichor is the phone propped beside the monitor in a draft lobby: one answer per screen — who you are playing, the six in buy order with gold spent, one sentence comparing it to what the god's players buy — with the reasoning one tap below. A broadcast lower-third printed on ink: flat near-black, condensed uppercase names over Sofia Sans, and one hue (violet) that means the model or the selection.
keyCharacteristics: One answer per screen; detail is a disclosure away, never a scroll past.
Dark only, flat ground, two lifted surfaces and a hairline.
Violet is selection, the primary action and the model talking — nothing else.
Condensed uppercase for names, gold and controls; Sofia Sans for anything read as a sentence.
One authored motion: the lock-in when an enemy pick changes a row.
A bottom tab bar on a phone; a top bar with the command field and a second column from 1024px.

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: Violet appears only on the current selection, the primary action, or the model's own voice.

rules.name: The Ink-Outline Enemy Rule
rules.body: The enemy team has no hue: a 1.5px ink ring and the word Enemy, never red.

rules.name: The Readable-Floor Rule
rules.body: Every text tier clears AA on every surface, and nothing is set below 12px.

rules.name: The Caption Rule
rules.body: Condensed caps are for names and controls; sentences are set in Sofia Sans.

rules.name: The Plain-Number Rule
rules.body: On the main path a number is gold or a share of a god's players, with its unit in words.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-It-Floats Rule
rules.body: A resting row, card or field has no shadow; shadow means above the page.

dos: Do give each screen one answer and put the reasoning one tap below it.
Do spend violet only on selection, the primary action, or the model's voice — per the One Hue Rule.
Do draw the enemy in an ink outline and say "Enemy" in words.
Do set names, gold and controls in Sofia Sans Extra Condensed uppercase, and sentences in Sofia Sans.
Do keep every tap target ≥44px and every text ≥12px at AA contrast.
Do let overlays (suggestions, sheets) sit above the page; never let them push layout.
Do put chosen state in the URL and flush queued writes before navigating.
Do say what wasn't measured in the same sentence as what was.
donts: Don't bring back torchlight gold, Rajdhani, Inter, JetBrains Mono, the god-picker rail, lens tabs, or the floating draft dock.
Don't add a second accent hue, or colour the enemy red.
Don't print a bare decimal on the main path (fit 0.69, quality 0.584); write gold or "N% of players".
Don't put an eyebrow over a heading, or a coloured border-left on a row.
Don't add a second command field to a screen that already has one, or a field to the phone god page.
Don't truncate a name a player needs to read (an aspect, a god, an item); wrap it.
Don't shadow a resting surface; shadow means it floats.
Don't rank or tier Joust or Arena.
